title: MSSQL migration alterColumn on a column with default value NULL creates wrong CONSTRAINT
body:
### What steps will reproduce the problem?
On MS SQL SERVER (test on 2017 and 2019)
Creating a migration with alterColumn on a column with default value = NULL

When a migration is created with
$this->alterColumn('table','column',$this->integer()->null()->defaultValue(NULL));

even string() or even using:
$this->alterColumn('table','column',$this->string(30).' NULL DEFAULT NULL');

### What is the expected result?
Migration creates a DEFAULT RUL similar to this one:
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[table] ADD  DEFAULT (NULL) FOR [column]

### What do you get instead?
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[table] ADD  CONSTRAINT [DF_table_column]  DEFAULT ('NULL') FOR [column];

### Additional info
This leads to errors if the field is not initialized on the SAVE operation.

It does not happen during a createTable()

--------------
This code:
```
        $this->createTable('{{%test}}',[
            'id'=>$this->primaryKey(),
            'strx' => $this->string(20)->null()->defaultValue(NULL),
            'intx'=>$this->integer()->null()->defaultValue(NULL),
            'aaa'=>$this->string(20)->null()->defaultValue('ZZ'),
        ]);
        
        $this->addColumn('{{%test}}','clm',$this->integer()->null()->defaultValue(NULL));

        $this->addColumn('{{%test}}','clm2',$this->integer()->null()->defaultValue(NULL));

        $this->alterColumn('{{%test}}','clm',$this->integer()->null()->defaultValue(NULL));
        
        $this->alterColumn('{{%test}}','strx',$this->string(30)->null());

```

generates this table definition:
```
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[test](
	[id] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	[strx] [nvarchar](30) NULL,
	[intx] [int] NULL,
	[aaa] [nvarchar](20) NULL,
	[clm] [int] NULL,
	[clm_ok] [int] NULL
) ON [PRIMARY]
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[test] ADD PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED 
(
	[id] ASC
)WITH (PAD_INDEX = OFF, STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, SORT_IN_TEMPDB = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, ONLINE = OFF, ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = ON, ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = ON) ON [PRIMARY]
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[test] ADD  CONSTRAINT [DF_test_strx]  DEFAULT ('NULL') FOR [strx]
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[test] ADD  DEFAULT (NULL) FOR [intx]
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[test] ADD  DEFAULT ('ZZ') FOR [aaa]
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[test] ADD  CONSTRAINT [DF_test_clm]  DEFAULT ('NULL') FOR [clm]
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[test] ADD  DEFAULT (NULL) FOR [clm_ok]
GO

```
